To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

PLGA conjugated Cm-NPs and PLGA conjugated Em-NPs modulate the amyloidogenesis of gelsolin by accelerating fibrillation or by inducing non-fibrillary aggregates, respectively, thereby reducing the cytotoxicity.

curcumin and its PLGA conjugate, curcumin nanoparticles (CmNPs), can modulate gelsolin fibrillation by skipping the pre-amyloid assemblies, whereas, the emetine nanoparticles (EmNPs) can induce non-fibrillated aggregates of gelsolin.
PLGA conjugation improves pharmacokinetic and therapeutic efficacy of two amyloid modulatory small molecules, curcumin and E-metine.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the use of curcumin, emetine and their PLGA nanoparticles as therapeutic agents against gelsolin amyloi
the design and development of novel nanocarrier-based drug delivery system for effective modulation of gelsolin aggregation.
the development of small-molecule based therapeutic intervention against gelsolin amylogenesis.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

PLGA encapsulation of small molecules can be an effective strategy to modulate amyloid fibrillization and toxicity, and thus, can be a promising strategy to develop effective amyloid modulatory therapeutics.
the use of PLGA encapsulated small molecules can be a potential therapeutic intervention for amyloid related diseases.
the amyloidogenesis of gelsolin is effectively modulated by curcumin and Emtiene conjugated nanoparticles, which may have potential applications in amyloidosis.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the PLGA conjugation strategy can be extended to other small molecules to improve the pharmacokinetic properties of these molecules and their potential as amyloid modulators.
the amyloidogenesis of gelsolin can be modulated by curcumin and/or emetine conjugated PLGA nanoparticles.
the amyloid fibrils of gelsolin can be reduced by two independent pathways: by stalling fibrillation process with Cm-NPs or by defibrillating with Em-NPs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
amyloidogenesis can be modulated by small molecules and that the process can be accelerated or retarded depending on the nature of the small molecule used.
amyloid fibrillation can be effectively controlled by small molecule conjugated nanoparticles, which can be used for the development of novel anti-amyloid therapeutic strategies.
the amyloidogenic potential and cytotoxicity of amyloids can both be modulated by small molecules, which can be used to develop effective therapeutic strategies against amyloidoses.
